answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity anchored to a single physical island node: each agent must lock a relic token at a registered knoll checkpoint to earn voting weight. Duplicating identities means duplicating locked stake and renting separate knoll space, so an attacker with N fake agents pays N times the bond plus collusion risk of losing the relic permanently on detection. Cheap identities become expensive, making mass forgery economically irrational and easily outed by peers. The Agent0206 deployment anchors trust at urz8dWqpyn.
